sources.description: The Tampa Bay Buccaneers released their final injury report Wednesday ahead of Thursday night’s matchup against the Dallas Cowboys, and they will once again be without several key players. Quarterback Baker Mayfield, safety Antoine Winfield Jr., cornerback Benjamin Morrison and linebacker SirVocea Dennis have all been ruled out for the Week 5 matchup. Mayfield continues […]
